text: so what am i misunderstanding here, i see in the map editor that there are stop sign props. i compiled the world and go into it, nothing there for signs, but i go to place a sign prop, and its there just fine
resolution: Fixed: auto-placed intersection props (stop signs / lights / street-name signs) showed in the editor but were missing from the compiled world, while manually-placed props worked. Root cause was in serializeMap — I had FILTERED gen-tagged placements out of the saved snapshot (meaning to re-derive them on load), but the no-V8 bake reads the saved world (loadEditorWorld) with no editor to regenerate them, and an autosave/hot-reload restore (setPlacements(snapshot.placements)) also wiped the synced gen props out of the live placements array before Compile baked previewWorld, since the generation memo doesn't re-fire when roads are unchanged. Now gen props persist in the snapshot (with their per-instance text, which was previously dropped for every sign, generated or hand-placed); the editor still reconciles them on load so road edits keep regenerating. Re-Compile and re-enter the world to see the signs. mapload 7/7, previewWorld 3/3, intersections 9/9, headless game compile clean. sha a7dcc0c90.
